issues.what: Narrow vertical spills on an enclosing, striated wall with sheer slabs replace the broad diagonal flow from a broken rocky opening and separate rugged right-hand outcrop with hazy space behind it.
issues.fix: Restore the broad diagonal flow and separate irregular rock silhouettes with space receding between them.

issues.what: One tight diagonal molten seam on nearly level striated ground replaces branching hot pools and cracks among raised black crust.
issues.fix: Break up the seam into irregular connected pools and secondary cracks through the lower right and midground.

issues.what: The tendrils stay dull, with weak spill on the animal and crust and almost no warm steam.
issues.fix: Brighten the contact into a hot pool, light the tendrils, lower neck, nearby legs and crust from below, and add a localized warm vapor curl.

issues.what: An even gray-brown veil and flat low-contrast illumination replace patchy smoke and stronger orange rim lighting on dark charcoal silhouettes.
issues.fix: Break up the veil and localize the orange rim light and bounce.

issues.where: cave mouth and top of cascade
issues.what: The opening is smaller and narrower, an opaque dark hole with a nearly horizontal sill instead of a broad, receding ribbed arch above an exposed molten shelf.
issues.fix: Widen and deepen the opening, reveal the curved inner rock, and make the upper lip a broad irregular lava-fed shelf.

issues.what: Thin, dull honey-colored ribbons on separate ledges end in a tiny horizontal line instead of a bright branching cascade spreading into a broad incandescent fan with dark crust islands.
issues.fix: Join the spills across the ledges, widen the lower fan, and restore yellow-white cores with orange spill on nearby rock.

issues.what: One enlarged animal at lower left replaces two tiny silhouettes at lower right along the lava toe.
issues.fix: Restore two small, distant, lava-backlit animals along the right-hand runout.

issues.what: A widespread brown veil obscures rock and compresses contrast, with an isolated soft orange cloud at right.
issues.fix: Clear the left slope and mouth, put patchier warm fume along the active flow, and keep the shadows charcoal.

issues.where: back of basin between lead and right animals
issues.what: Two distant silhouettes occupy what is open smoky space in the target.
issues.fix: Remove the background pair while keeping the main three.

issues.where: nearest ground and planted and lifted feet
issues.what: Continuous ripples replace broken volcanic relief and the dark defocused rock at lower left; feet have weak surface contact and the lifted foot drops no grit.
issues.fix: Add the near occluding rock, patchy crust and contact occlusion, and falling grit under the lifted foot.

issues.what: The flat, almost featureless floor loses the defocused dark rocky lip and warm diagonal fissure.
issues.fix: Bring back both as a separate near plane.

issues.what: A smooth slope, spaced blocky boulders, and uniform bands replace dense, varied scree and fractured rock faces.
issues.fix: Add angular rubble in a range of sizes and break up the faces and edges of the benches.

note: The critic first answered in prose with the same score and the same twelve issues; asked for the one JSON object of the brief, it sent this.
